tables.caption: MICs and therapeutic index of the peptides.
footnotes: 1 Minimum hemolysis concentration 5% (MHC5) is defined as the lowest peptide concentration that induces 5% hemolysis. When no detectable hemolytic activity was observed at 256 μM, a value of 512 μM was used to calculate the therapeutic index. 2 Geometric mean (GM) of MIC values for the 10 bacteria were tested. When no detectable antimicrobial activity was observed at 128 μM, a value of 256 μM was used to calculate the therapeutic index. 3 Therapeutic index (TI) was calculated as MHC5/GM.
